runs.text: One Arab judge. One former president, sent to prison. December thirty, two thousand and ten. Tel Aviv. Israel's former president, Moshe Katsav, hears the verdict. The judge leading the panel: George Karra. An Arab Christian, born in Jaffa. The verdict: guilty, of rape and other sexual offences. The sentence: seven years in prison. Katsav appeals to the Supreme Court. One of the three justices: Salim Joubran, also an Arab citizen. November twenty eleven: the appeal is rejected. Unanimously. December twenty eleven: Israel's former head of state walks into prison. And Judge Karra? In twenty seventeen, he joined Israel's Supreme Court. No single case proves equality. Israel's civil service target for Arab staff is just ten percent, unchanged since two thousand and eight. Could this happen in your country? Tell me below. So here's the headline nobody shares.
